label: Range
script:
on error resume next
Set oView = Desktop.ActiveLayout.Views ("lower_panel")
if oView = "" then
	ToggleOptionalPanel "Timerange"
Else
	ShowOptionalPanel "View Manager"
	ToggleOptionalPanel "Lower Panel"
End if

label: Reset
script:
set vw = Desktop.ActiveLayout.Views.Find( "View Manager" )
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","true"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","standard"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","reset"
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","false"

label: Alternate
script:
set vw = Desktop.ActiveLayout.Views.Find( "View Manager" )
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","true"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","alternate"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","reset"
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","false"
vw.setattributevalue "focusedviewport", "d"

label: Exp
script:
set vw = Desktop.ActiveLayout.Views.Find( "View Manager" )
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","true"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","standard"
vw.setattributevalue "viewport:a","explorer"
vw.setattributevalue "activecamera:d","user"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","vertical:a"
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","false"
set myexplorer = vw.views("a")
myexplorer.setattributevalue "scope","Scene"

label: Tree
tooltip: ICE Tree, Render Tree, Animation Editor
script:
on error resume next
'find the view manager
set vw = Desktop.ActiveLayout.Views.Find( "View Manager" )
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","true"
vw.setattributevalue "layout","standard"
vw.setattributevalue "viewport:a","explorer"

'we want to populate the horizontal C view depending on the module
'check the hidden user prefs 
set oPreferences = Application.Preferences
oVal = oPreferences.GetPreferenceValue( "xsiprivate_unclassified.SI3D_CURRENT_MODULE" )

if oVal = "ICE_MODULE" then
	vw.setattributevalue "viewport:c","ICE Tree"
Elseif (oVal = "ANIMATION_MODULE") then
	vw.setattributevalue "viewport:c","Animation Editor"
Elseif (oVal = "RENDERING_MODULE") then
	vw.setattributevalue "viewport:c","Render Tree"
Elseif (oVal = "SIMULATE_MODULE") then
	vw.setattributevalue "viewport:c","ICE Tree"
Else 
	vw.setattributevalue "viewport:c","Render Tree"
End if

'finsih the layout changes
vw.setattributevalue "layout","horizontal:c"
vw.setattributevalue "suspenddrawing","false"
